title: BBC News - Breaking news, video and the latest top stories from the U.S. and around the world
meta: Visit BBC News for the latest news, breaking news, video, audio and analysis. BBC News provides trusted World, U.S. and U.K. news as well as local and regional perspectives. Also entertainment, climate, business, science, technology and health news.
content: In the UK, 32 government services are unavailable as security work takes place, but "this does not mean they were hacked", Downing Street says. The BBC's technology correspondent Joe Tidy explains how it happened, and what it means for you. With immigration curbs and tech firms cutting foreign hiring, US residency is becoming a distant dream for many Indians. The Swiss government told the BBC that the freed national was on her way back to Switzerland. The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region. The congresswoman said federal agents seized over a dozen items, including cell phones and notebooks, as part of a federal investigation. V Harish, who ran the hugely popular Instagram account "Finance with Harish", was found dead on Tuesday. Journalist Will Murray describes how he and a bystander saved an SUV driver from his vehicle. The actress tells BBC Radio 4's Today programme about how her eye condition has affected her life. After two years of student protests, Serbians vote on Sunday in elections that could bring down the ruling party. Many view it as one of the most pivotal elections in Israel's history, with global implications. With graduate jobs hard to come by, more young adults are reported to be considering emigrating. It has been a dramatic, public and global response, but the cyber event hasn't happened yet. No country for young men and women: why do older politicians seem to have such a tight grip on the US political system? As councillors prepare to banish the vehicles, views in Central Park are divided over the 160-year-old tradition. Videos from the Arizona capital show people sheltering inside a car as hail smashes the windscreen, while intense downpours covered neighbourhoods in ice. Bukangi the shark became an unlikely sensation after it was spotted in a canal in Busan weeks ago. Four members of the so-called Gang Suppression Force have been missing since Sunday. It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement targeting airports and other sites in the kingdom. Jim O'Callaghan described the video as "inappropriate and demeaning to grandparents". The bank says it is using more AI leading to a 5% reduction in its workforce. The disease, which usually affects cattle, has been identified in a patient who died in early October. Follow live text updates and BBC Radio 5 Sports Extra commentary as England face Sri Lanka as part of a one-day international tri-series in Rawalpindi. While head coach Michael Carrick is expected to be in charge for Sunday's match against Bournemouth, Manchester United begin the process of identifying possible replacements. Briton Freddie Slater will drive for Audi in first practice at the Mexico City and Sao Paulo Grands Prix. Why England Rugby World Cup winner Phil Vickery has started entering bodybuilding competitions at the age of 50. South Africa break Australia's resistance in the final session a complete a famous victory in the second Test and set up a series decider in Cape Town. Bruno Fernandes' comments after Manchester United's humbling by Como have got fans and pundits talking - but what now for the captain? Captain Harry Brook becomes the first England batter to make a double century in a one-day international with a sensational 202 against Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi. Copyright 2026 BBC.
